title: RF-DETR vs YOLOX: mAP and FPS for every variant
dek: RF-DETR averages 3.9 mAP points more than YOLOX at matched size, and RF-DETR-L hits 58.6 mAP. YOLOX runs 32.2% faster on an RTX 5070 Ti.
author: Vision Analysis

blocks.text: RF-DETR is more accurate per parameter: at matched size on an RTX 5070 Ti it averages 3.9 mAP points higher than YOLOX and wins 3 of 4 pairs, and RF-DETR-L tops the range at 58.6 mAP. YOLOX is 32.2% faster on average in PyTorch and scales from 0.91M to 99.07M parameters. Pick by accuracy per parameter against throughput and range.

RF-DETR fields 4 measured variants and YOLOX fields 6, all on the same COCO val2017 protocol on an RTX 5070 Ti. RF-DETR's variants sit between 30.47M and 33.93M parameters, so all 4 pair against YOLOX-M (25.33M) by count.

blocks.caption: Accuracy vs parameters on COCO val2017, RF-DETR and YOLOX variants highlighted against the full field.

blocks.text: mAP is shown in percent. Each RF-DETR variant is paired with the nearest YOLOX variant by parameter count, which is YOLOX-M at 51.7 mAP for all 4. RF-DETR-S, RF-DETR-M and RF-DETR-L win by 3.4, 5.6 and 6.9 points; RF-DETR-N trails at 51.4. The mean edge is 3.9 points. At the top, RF-DETR-L reaches 58.6 mAP; YOLOX-X, far heavier at 99.07M, reaches 56.3. At the small end YOLOX goes down to YOLOX-Nano (0.91M, 28.8 mAP), a size RF-DETR does not field.
Averaged across the 4 pairs, YOLOX is 32.2% faster than RF-DETR in PyTorch. YOLOX-M runs 48.2 FPS; the RF-DETR variants it faces run between 39.5 and 25.1 FPS, slowing as accuracy rises.

Pick RF-DETR for accuracy per parameter: RF-DETR-S and up beat their YOLOX match by 3.4 points or more, and RF-DETR-L reaches 58.6 mAP. Pick YOLOX for throughput, 32.2% faster on average, and for small models down to 0.91M parameters. Both ship under Apache-2.0, so licensing does not force the call.
